hypotheses: H1 private tasking:Rockbridge, Thiel or an intermediary urged Vance or task-force staff to adopt Palantir or specifications favoring Palantir.
H2 access without tasking:Vance briefed donors for political support while agencies independently selected Palantir.
H3 aligned implementation:Huemme or other network-linked staff transmitted priorities or arranged vendor access without a direct Thiel instruction.
H4 preexisting procurement:USDA or SBA began Palantir pilots before the task force or Rockbridge summit and the temporal sequence is coincidental.
H5 programmatic capture:task-force data-sharing and risk-control requirements systematically favored Palantir's existing government data platforms.
in_scope: Executive Order 14395 meeting minutes, agency submissions, implementation plans, vendor recommendations and technical-support requests
March 30, 2026 Rockbridge summit agenda, attendees, recordings, notes, briefing materials and follow-up
USDA award 12314426F0120 complete procurement file and data-access records
SBA Palantir pilot and expansion award identifiers, procurement file, pilot start date and task-force communications
Vance and Hannah Huemme calendars, emails, texts, preserved messages and visitor logs
Contacts involving Thiel, Buskirk, Palantir, Alex Karp, Shyam Sankar, USDA, SBA, GSA and task-force officials
Vance ethics advice or voluntary screening concerning Narya, Rockbridge, Palantir and task-force vendor decisions
objectives: Establish when USDA and SBA first considered Palantir and who initiated each procurement.
Identify whether the task force, Vance, Huemme or Rockbridge-affiliated persons transmitted vendor names, technical specifications or data-platform requirements.
Determine whether the USDA award was competed, sole-sourced or issued under an existing vehicle and identify all evaluated alternatives.
Identify all Palantir representatives and Rockbridge members present at or communicating around the March 30 summit.
Build a contact-to-requirement-to-award-to-benefit ledger with exact timestamps and document hashes.
out_of_scope: Calling temporal proximity proof of procurement corruption.
Assuming Thiel attended the March 30 summit without an attendee record.
Treating Palantir's government work as improper merely because Thiel chairs the company.
data.research_question: Did private Rockbridge access or Thiel-network personnel shape Vance's anti-fraud task force requirements or Palantir procurement outcomes?
selection_reason: The March 30 to April 6 interval is the narrowest unresolved access-to-award window in the current corpus.
